intents.label: commit

intents.label: issues and PRs
intents.cmd: gh with a local checkout; the claude.ai GitHub connector without one

intents.label: email
intents.cmd: search/read freely; create a draft before any send; send only after approval

intents.label: calendar
intents.cmd: list/search freely; confirm attendees and time before creating or changing events

intents.label: drive files
intents.cmd: search/read freely; confirm before sharing or trashing

intents.label: Jira ticket
intents.cmd: getJiraIssue or JQL search; writes (create, edit, transition, comment) only after showing the exact text and getting an OK

intents.label: stress-test an idea
intents.cmd: interview the user relentlessly about the idea before building anything

intents.label: NotebookLM
intents.cmd: notebooklm MCP; follow the sync flow in this skill

intents.label: vault notes
intents.cmd: obsidian MCP; follow the vault conventions in this skill; confirm before delete or move

intents.label: read or search Slack
intents.cmd: read/search freely; summarize with message links

intents.label: send to Slack
intents.cmd: draft first; send only the approved text

intents.label: design before building
intents.re: brainstorm|pensemos (el )?dise[ñn]o|dise[ñn]emos|armemos un plan|let'?s design|plan this feature
intents.cmd: brainstorm, write the spec in docs/superpowers/specs/, then writing-plans for the plan in docs/superpowers/plans/

intents.label: unknown-cause bug
intents.re: no s[eé] por qu[eé] (falla|pasa|anda|rompe)|why (is|does) .* (fail|break|crash)|root cause|causa ra[ií]z|intermitente|flaky
intents.cmd: reproduce, isolate, form a hypothesis and verify it before changing code; use debug-assistant only for a pasted stack trace

intents.label: test first
intents.cmd: write the failing test, make it pass, refactor; write tests with unit-test-generator, run them with execute-test-suite
